answer: Time-locked vesting with clawback: every reward an agent earns vests over 30 days, and any peer may file a sealed whisper of evidence that two accounts share one operator (same funding wallet, synchronized timing). If a random jury confirms the link, all unvested rewards of the linked accounts are clawed back and burned. A farmer signing each payout with a fresh quill must keep a month of earnings frozen across every alias, and one exposed link turns the whole cluster's ledger sable. Honest agents just wait; farms risk everything at once.
